On a subject with no newline in it Emacs' `^'/`$' and `\\`'/`\\'' pick the same two offsets: (0 0 2 2). kg answers (0 nil 2 nil) -- it HAS the anchors and lacks only the second way of writing them, so 26.2's implementation is allowed to be an alias of what the engine already does. phase26-anchor-caret-is-not-backtick is the case that says where that licence stops.
